obernants.operator: Let F be the explicit finite fixture set below, O(f) the oracle expectations and U the candidate implementations paired with pass/fail observations over F. R(P,pass) iff every assertion succeeds under the fixed execution assumptions. U minus R consists of false pass observations for any mismatch and false failure observations when every assertion holds.
